fixed_decoder: Fixed representation build times include reconstruction, and query times use already reconstructed memory arrays. They are audit costs, not deployable end-to-end compressed-query timing.
tree: Python traversal wall clock includes raw broker accounting and copies; NumPy full scan is vectorized and already resident. Lower logical bytes does not imply faster wall clock.
raw_bytes: Unique scalar float32 bytes fetched, per query. Index nodes may be reread and are counted per access. No physical disk-I/O measurement.
SQL: Returned rows cannot establish SQLite pages scanned. Do not put Sonar on raw-broker byte frontier.
full_baseline: All relevant channels counted: one channel for eight single-variable questions; two for ordering/cooccur. A bookkeeping correction changed only byte counts before aggregation, not predictions.
sampling: 8 independent record clusters, 24 contexts, 240 correlated QA; CIs resample records, not individual questions.
fixed_build_input_bytes: For fixed representations, index-build input_bytes is source-array extent, not instrumented accesses; uniform sampling can touch fewer values. The amortized indexed-baseline table includes only full scan, EventIndex and MinMax+Sum, not this unprofiled fixed-encoder count.
